title: 2020 Panini Donruss American Pride #90/349 Alec Burleson Joey Gallo Silver
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020 Panini Donruss American Pride trading card features Alec Burleson and Joey Gallo from the USA Baseball 18U National Team and USA Baseball Collegiate National Team. The card is a parallel/variety, with a card number of AP19, and is part of the Rapture insert set. It is a sports trading card with a silver design, perfect for any baseball fan. 

The card is manufactured by Panini and is a rookie insert, making it a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection. This card is from the 2020 season and is part of the USA Baseball league. Add this card to your collection today!
